luiskr.com / experiments/docs/copy-guard / attachCopyGuard

function attachCopyGuard(
   root, 
   isProtected, 
   getPath, 
   toastText
): GuardDisposer;

Defined in: experiments/docs/copy-guard.ts:64

Wires every guard listener onto root (typically the viewer container or the component shadow root). isProtected gates interception so the guard only bites while a protected page (source-code file) is open — normal browsing of docs/reports keeps full clipboard freedom.

Parameters

root

HTMLElement | ShadowRoot

Element/ShadowRoot to attach to.

isProtected

() => boolean

Whether the current view is guarded right now.

getPath

() => string

Returns the current docs path for telemetry.

toastText

() => string

Localized toast message getter.

Returns

GuardDisposer

Disposer removing every listener.
